summary: Backend SEO verification for the new blog/Journal section against the preview base URL. All 8 curl-based checks pass: crawler /blog index, all 3 article slugs with unique titles/H1 and Article+FAQPage+BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, 404 for unknown slug, sitemap.xml now includes /blog and all 3 posts, humans still get untouched SPA shell, and the collection page baked in the cross-link to /blog/what-makes-leggings-squat-proof.
critical_code_review_comments: Article body prose contains literal quote characters ('"Squat proof"') that render as " in HTML — acceptable but note that any downstream string matching (or SGE snippet checks) should normalise entities.

seo.py is now the single source of truth for blog content; consider keeping /app/frontend/src/data/blogPosts.js and seo.py BLOG dict in sync via a shared JSON to avoid drift between crawler HTML and hydrated SPA view.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_blog_seo.py covers crawler vs human UA branching, /blog index, 3 blog posts, 404, sitemap, and collection→blog cross-link. Titles/H1s of the three articles verified unique. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env; hits frontend host which proxies crawler UAs via seo-middleware.js.
